name: Car Parking Sensor
summary: Ultrasonic parking sensor with OLED distance readout, zone buzzer, and a serial link that lets a browser dashboard retune it live.
hardware: SSD1306 128x32 OLED — VCC:5V, GND:GND, SDA:A4, SCL:A5, addr 0x3C
LED — long leg via 220-330R resistor to pin 6, short leg to GND
Piezo buzzer — + to pin 7, - to GND
notes: parking_sensor/ is the restore point — flashing it returns the board to its original state. Stop the dashboard before flashing; it holds COM3.
